description: Labelled product-search queries for eval/run_retrieval.py (Phase 0). Each query's expected products come from SQL rules over raw name and price (never category columns), materialised to product ids by eval/label_queries.py --write. 'exact' = everything asked for; 'ok' = right kind of product but misses a constraint. Queries with expect_none must show no products (out of scope).

macros.MIXER: ((name ~* 'mixer' AND name ~* 'grinder') OR name ~* 'mixer juicer|juicer mixer')
macros.SPEAKER: (name ~* 'speaker|soundbar|sound bar|home theat' AND name !~* '\mstands?\M|mount|cable|\mwires?\M|grill|cover|coupler|bracket|adapter|case|\mbag\M|watch|earbud|headphone|neckband|calling|printer')
macros.VACUUM: (name ~* 'vacuum' AND name ~* 'cleaner|robot|mop|wet and dry|wet & dry|handheld|cordless' AND name !~* 'dust ?bags?|\mbags? for|spare|replacement|hose|nozzle|flask|bottle|container|storage|sealer|food')
macros.INDUCTION: (name ~* 'induction' AND name ~* 'cooktop|cook top|stove|chulha|chula|\mhob\M' AND name !~* '\mbase\M|vessel|\mpan\M|tawa|kadai|bottom|compatible|cookware|pressure cooker')
macros.ROUTER: (name ~* '\mrouter\M|archer (a|c)\d' AND name ~* 'wi-?fi|wireless|dual band|mbps|archer' AND name !~* '\mups\M|power ?backup|power supply|adapter|stand|table|cable|patch')

label.ok: ({MOUSE} AND {WIRELESS} AND price <= 625) OR ({MOUSE} AND price <= 500)
